summary.en: A scene in the dark is shown only where a lamp falls: a spot swings and opens like an iris, grows from a corner, or crosses and leaves the scene dark.
summary.zh: 黑场里只有灯照到的地方才看得见：光斑像钟摆一样摆动后光圈张开，或从角落匀速扩张点亮，或匀速扫过、照到即亮光走即暗。

fits: A dark opening or a dark section that introduces a title or a panel: the light decides what the viewer sees.
notFor: Light styles (a lamp on a light ground shows nothing); more than one dark section a film; more than two light effects in all.

intent.en: In the dark the viewer sees only what the light gives, so the lamp decides what appears and when: lighting as camera and edit.
intent.zh: 黑暗里观众只看得见光给的东西，由灯决定什么登场、何时登场：光就是运镜和剪辑。

content.en: One scene to light: a title (≤ 24 chars) or a UI panel; for pass and pan an edge for the light to run along.
content.zh: 一个要被照亮的场景：标题（≤ 10 字）或一块界面面板；pass、pan 两式还要给光贴着走的边。

fits.zh: 黑场开场或暗色段落里引出一个标题或一块面板：光决定观众看什么。

notFor.zh: 浅色风格（浅底上的灯什么也照不出）；一支片不止一个暗段；全片光效加起来超过两次。

en: Dark grounds only: on a light ground the light shows nothing.
All light effects together at most twice a film; light cheapens fastest.
grow, pass and pan must move at constant speed (an eased light looks intentional, not a searchlight), and a grow radius too large saturates in the first quarter.
pass and pan need the edge light running with them; a bare spot has no identity.
zh: 只用于深底：浅底上光照不出东西。
全片光效合计最多两次，光是最快掉价的手法。
grow、pass、pan 必须匀速（带缓动的光像有意图，不像探照灯）；grow 终值半径过大会在前四分之一就饱和。
pass、pan 要带贴边光线同行，裸聚光没有身份。
